method.description: Horizontal non-overlapping box averages at each z; all boxes and z levels enter <F_lambda^2> jointly; ordinary least-squares fit of log moment versus log box size; C1 = K(2)*(alpha-1)/(2^alpha-2).
method.clip_fraction_definition: Pre-clip negative point-updates divided by all point-updates across dyadic classes, substeps, and realizations.

execution.backend: CPU; NumPy fields with STEAM's Torch CPU FFT convolution
